verdict.headline: This NDA is highly one-sided, imposing perpetual liability with no standard exceptions while leaving your own disclosures unprotected.
summary: The agreement defines confidential information to include public and pre-existing knowledge and excludes standard exceptions such as disclosures required by law.
Your confidentiality obligations last forever and include an indemnity for full legal costs, while the discloser refuses any duty to keep your own tender data confidential.
Only the discloser may terminate the contract, and you are barred from sharing information with your professional advisers or financiers without prior written consent.

summary: The contract strips statutory consumer safeguards by allowing immediate repossession without notice upon a single default and disclaiming the right to return the vehicle.

It completely excludes vehicle warranties and forces sole-arbitrator dispute resolution in Klang with an abbreviated three-month limitation window.

verdict.headline: High risk due to full deposit forfeiture on early exit, automatic 2-year lock-in renewal, and one-sided 7-day landlord termination.
summary: The agreement forfeits your entire RM1,500 deposit if you leave early regardless of whether the landlord suffers any actual financial loss.
It automatically renews the lease for a lengthy 2-year term unless you give 60 days' written notice before expiry.
The landlord can evict you on any ground with only 7 days' notice, while you are forced to give 2 full months' notice to exit.
